supporting_observations.claim: The large transfer itself is consistent with the approved backup workflow: FILE-NWD-01 ran the inventoried StratoSafe executable as svc-archive toward the approved StratoSafe endpoint, and the proxy and connection logs record about 640 MB sent.

The domain controller recorded a service-ticket request for svc-archive from 139.162.174.124, followed shortly by a svc-archive service logon on FILE-NWD-01. Given the stated absence of VPN, the external source is anomalous and supports suspected unauthorized use of the account.

nora.blake initiated RDP to FILE-NWD-01 and successfully logged on interactively. This is inconsistent with the stated practice that remote administration is only done from WS-SOKAFOR-01, and the session overlaps the transfer period.

FILE-NWD-01 was the source of NTLM validation for sam.okafor, and WS-SOKAFOR-01 recorded a network logon for that account from FILE-NWD-01. This is an additional unexplained credential-use anomaly on the file server.

known_telemetry_limitations: The logs identify the transfer process, destination, and byte count but do not reveal the contents or business purpose of the uploaded data.
The proxy records a tunnel and a separate inspected GET, but the provided records do not show inspection of the bulk transfer payload.
The records do not establish who controlled the external IP or whether the svc-archive authentication was authorized.
Process and authentication records do not show the contents of the certificate-health script or establish whether the executables and scripts were unmodified.
claims_not_established: That the 640 MB upload contained stolen or otherwise unauthorized data; its observed destination and process match the approved backup service.
That the external svc-archive ticket request was definitively attacker-controlled rather than a misconfigured or otherwise legitimate source.
That nora.blake or sam.okafor intentionally participated in malicious activity.
That the scheduled svc-render password rotation caused or is connected to the observed transfer.
additional_evidence_needed: Confirm with StratoSafe and the backup owner whether the 13:45 job, source IP, volume, and svc-archive authentication were expected; obtain destination-side upload records.
Determine the owner and purpose of 139.162.174.124 and investigate how it obtained or used svc-archive credentials.
Review FILE-NWD-01 RDP session activity and session attribution for nora.blake, including commands, file access, and session details.
Investigate the sam.okafor network authentication from FILE-NWD-01, including the initiating process, authentication method, and any resulting access.
Collect relevant endpoint and script contents, scheduled-task/service configuration, and authentication records around the svc-render rotation and the observed events.
